page.lead: What AnyLearn remembers about how you study. Every entry is yours to edit or delete. Features read it only when they need it: Mastery reads your Preferences and Struggles, Chat reads your Preferences, and Research never reads it.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.hint: What has held up over time.

struggles.title: Struggles
struggles.hint: Mistakes or points that keep coming back.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.hint: How you like things explained: examples, language, pace.

entry.editHint: Once you edit an entry it is yours, and nightly suggestions never change it.

proposals.title: Proposed
proposals.hint: Suggested from your activity. Nothing here is used by any feature until you accept it; a rejected suggestion is not made again for 30 days.

add.title: Add an entry
add.text: What should AnyLearn keep in mind?

consolidation.title: Nightly suggestions
consolidation.body: When this is on, AnyLearn looks once a night, at 02:00 in your time zone and only after a day with new activity, at your quiz, mastery, vocabulary and skill-card results, and proposes entries. It makes one call on your own chat model and reads counts and results only, never your documents or anything you wrote. Nothing it proposes is used until you accept it.

clear.title: Clear profile
clear.body: Removes every entry, proposals included. Your quiz, mastery and vocabulary history is not touched.

errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.full: That section already holds 12 entries. Delete one first.
errors.conflict: That entry changed since this page loaded. It has been refreshed.
errors.invalid: An entry needs some text, at most 280 characters.
